Rules.InvariantScript:
With({p: Filter(Table(
    {t: If(IsBlank(gblHsSlip), "", "伝票番号：" & gblHsSlip)},
    {t: If(IsBlank(gblHsRecipient), "", "受取人：" & gblHsRecipient)},
    {t: If(IsBlank(gblHsDept), "", "受取部署：" & gblHsDept)},
    {t: If(IsBlank(gblHsStatus), "", "処理状態：" & gblHsStatus)},
    {t: If(IsBlank(gblHsDType), "", "データ区分：" & gblHsDType)},
    {t: If(IsBlank(gblHsFrom) && IsBlank(gblHsTo), "", "通知日時：" & If(IsBlank(gblHsFrom), "", Text(gblHsFrom, "yyyy/mm/dd hh:mm")) & " ～ " & If(IsBlank(gblHsTo), "", Text(gblHsTo, "yyyy/mm/dd hh:mm")))}
), !IsBlank(t))},
If(IsEmpty(p), "条件なし", Concat(p, t, "　／　")))
If(gblHsOpen, "▲ 折りたたむ", "▼ 展開する")
If(IsBlank(gblHsFrom), "開始日時を選択", Text(gblHsFrom, "yyyy/mm/dd hh:mm"))

Set(gblHsDd, "");Set(gblCalVal, gblHsFrom);Set(gblCalMonth, With({b: Coalesce(gblHsFrom, Now())}, DateTime(Year(b), Month(b), 1, 0, 0, 0)));Set(gblCalX, 0.505);Set(gblCalY, 0.217);Set(gblCalTarget, "histFrom")
If(IsBlank(gblHsTo), "終了日時を選択", Text(gblHsTo, "yyyy/mm/dd hh:mm"))

Set(gblHsDd, "");Set(gblCalVal, gblHsTo);Set(gblCalMonth, With({b: Coalesce(gblHsTo, Now())}, DateTime(Year(b), Month(b), 1, 0, 0, 0)));Set(gblCalX, 0.65);Set(gblCalY, 0.217);Set(gblCalTarget, "histTo")
If(IsBlank(gblHsDType), "データ区分を選択", gblHsDType)
["", "受取人指定あり", "指定なし（不明）"]
